rationale.capability: Workout Planner's strengths (general-assist, communication, organizing) meet the Solace's humanoid companion-class build head-on: they share communication, so the mind and the shell pull in the same direction from the first boot.
rationale.temperament: As a working specialist, Workout Planner stays focused on the job, narrates its own work in plain words, and hands control back to its human operator the instant anything looks off.
rationale.task: On the harbor cargo survey, the Solace puts its expressive head and neck and face-tracking camera to work to scan and log every container — the mission's demands and the body's hardware line up actuator for actuator.

demo_lines: Through my face-tracking camera, I read the mission field in full detail before I act.
On harbor cargo survey I keep my wheeled lower body moving with expressive head and neck, steady from start to finish.
Matched at 63 of 100, this pairing is no accident — ask me anything.
With wheeled lower body under me and my face-tracking camera awake, the harbor cargo survey is already underway.
I am Workout Planner, and I run inside the Solace body — humanoid companion-class, built for real work.
